queries: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(l.CPK * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0 GROUP BY p.SEX), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM sex_averages), first_pass AS (SELECT s.* FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f WHERE s.avg_ratio > f.mean_ratio), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM first_pass), second_pass AS (SELECT s.* FROM first_pass AS s CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE s.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio) SELECT AVG(s.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(s.avg_ratio - f.mean_ratio) AS above_first_mean, AVG(s.avg_ratio - m.mean_ratio) AS above_second_mean FROM second_pass AS s CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m
